{{samename|[[Pokémon Masters EX]] character|Eve (Masters)}} [[File:Eve.png|250px|thumb|Eve]] '''Dr. Eve''' (Japanese: '''ホクト''' ''Hokuto'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP072|The Ancient Puzzle of Pokémopolis]]''. She claims to be extremely intelligent, saying that she got her doctorate degree when she was only nine years old, but this is left in doubt due to her rather arrogant and hasty personality. An archaeologist, Eve took credit for uncovering the ancient lost city of [[Pokémopolis]], despite the fact that {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} actually found it; it was located near modern-day [[Pallet Town]]. However, Eve soon learned that her discovery was much more complicated and dangerous than it seemed. After accidentally awakening a {{pkmn2|giant}} {{p|Gengar}} and {{p|Alakazam}}, Eve was horrified at what she had done and feared that the two would destroy Pallet Town and the entire {{pkmn|world}}. Thankfully, a giant {{p|Jigglypuff}} put the other giants to {{status|sleep}}, and everything went back to normal. Although Eve had been terrified at what happened, it didn't frighten her away from continuing to be an archaeologist. In fact, it made her want to study Pokémopolis even more than ever. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{unknown color}}|bordercolor={{unknown color light}} |ja=今井由香 ''Yuka Imai'' |en=[[Amy Birnbaum]] |ar=فدوى سليمان ''Fadwa Souleimane'' |pt_br=Raquel Marinho |cs=Jolana Smyčková |fi=Elise Langenoja |fr_eu=Guylaine Gibert |hi= प्रज्ञा पांड्या शाह ''{{wp|Parignya Pandya Shah}}''(Hungama dub) |no=Katrine Blomstrand |es_eu=Sandra Jara |pl=Anna Dąbkowska}} ==Trivia== * In the Japanese version, it is said that Eve deciphered the ancient Pokémopolis alphabet at 6 years old. * In the English dub, Eve was given a French accent. * Her English name may be a reference to the female lead in ''{{wp|The Mummy (1999 film)|The Mummy}}''.
